title: 지도교수 면담: 논문이 왜 늦어졌는지 설명하기
objective: You can politely tell your advisor about an unexpected problem that delayed your work using -는 바람에.
summary: A graduate student explains to their advisor why a thesis draft is late, using -는 바람에.
setting: A professor's office at a university. A graduate student knocks on the door to talk about a late thesis chapter.

task.title: Explain delays to your advisor
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list, and -는 바람에 to complete each item.

words.example: 다음 주 화요일에 교수님과 면담이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I have a meeting with my professor next Tuesday.
You have to write a thesis to graduate.

words.example: 데이터 분석에 생각보다 시간이 많이 걸렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The data analysis took more time than I expected.
I sent a survey out to 100 students.
I'll send you the materials this evening.

words.meaning: because (something unexpected happened), usually with a bad result. Verb stem + 는 바람에, even for past events. The second part is usually in the past and cannot be a command or suggestion.
words.exampleMeaning: I missed the bus, so I was late for class.

dialogue.korean: 교수님, 안녕하세요. 지금 잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, Professor. Do you have a moment now?

dialogue.korean: 네, 들어와요. 논문은 잘 진행되고 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, come in. Is your thesis going well?

dialogue.korean: 사실 그 일 때문에 왔습니다. 설문 응답이 늦게 들어오는 바람에 분석을 아직 못 끝냈습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Actually, that's why I came. The survey responses came in late, so I haven't finished the analysis yet.
Then by when can you send it?

dialogue.korean: 다음 주 금요일까지 보내 드려도 될까요?
dialogue.meaning: Would it be all right if I sent it to you by next Friday?

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 대신 분석 방법은 먼저 정리해서 이번 주 안에 메일로 보내 줘요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay. But write up your analysis method first and email it to me by the end of this week.

exercises: Join the two sentences with -는 바람에: 프린터가 고장 났어요. / 자료를 못 뽑았어요.
Choose the ending that fits with -는 바람에: ① 비가 많이 오는 바람에 (발표가 연기됐어요 / 우산을 가져가세요). ② 서버가 다운되는 바람에 (보고서를 같이 냅시다 / 보고서를 제출하지 못했어요).
Fill in each blank with a word from the word list: ① 교수님, 이번 주에 ____ 시간을 잡을 수 있을까요? ② 데이터 ____ 결과는 표로 정리했습니다. ③ 졸업 ____ 주제를 아직 못 정했어요.
Write one sentence in Korean using -는 바람에: You deleted your data file by mistake (파일이 지워지다), so your submission is late (제출이 늦어지다). Tell your advisor politely.
answers: 프린터가 고장 나는 바람에 자료를 못 뽑았어요. (자료를 뽑지 못했어요)
① 발표가 연기됐어요 ② 보고서를 제출하지 못했어요
① 면담 ② 분석 ③ 논문
